claims.statement: For a Parseval frame z_i in R^3 with alpha=max ||z_i||^2<1/3, some bipartition P,Q satisfies det(G_P)det(G_Q)>=(1-3alpha)/64. Applied to the heavy-null normalized complement this yields Pi_3(A[P,Q])>=D(1-c)sqrt(1-3alpha)/8 and hence the exact-cross-rank density bound. In particular alpha<=1/4, D>=1/2, c<=61/64 gives ||p_Q||_infinity<71.805.

If c<=61/64 and ell_j>1/4, writing u_j=a r+z, either ||z||^2>1/8, in which case the exact complete principal-triple mass through singleton banks {0},{j} is mu_0j=D c ||z||^2>7/144, or a^2/(1-c)>1/8. The latter can hold for at most seven complement rows. After applying fleet03/B19 r19, every unpaid transverse row additionally satisfies |A_jj|<1/256 and |A_0j|<sqrt(5)/128.

Pay the residual exact-rank-three heavy-null state consisting of either c<=61/64 with max normalized leverage>1/4 after the named-partner scalar/pair payments (finite longitudinal-heavy core or explicit double-near-null/O3 packet), or the punctured near-unit chamber 61/64<c<1. Arbitrary additional spectrum remains a separate full-target debt.
